title: Figure 7. A Stargate (adapted from Reference 9): cartoon drawings of flat-faced wormholes
description: Cartoon line drawings illustrating a flat-faced wormhole or stargate: a person looking through a circular portal at a dinosaur, two dinosaurs beside a small portal with a face visible through it, a wild-haired man with a vertical portal through his torso, and an arm passing through a portal. Caption reads "Figure 7. A Stargate (adapted from Reference 9)". Text above explains that a stargate would not distort the image seen through it.
